scope: Model: put=INSERT OR IGNORE, AFTER INSERT trigger logging one row, channel=main total_changes or main+other total_changes. Simulate actions to predict channel, committed_count, committed_sum. Unresolved when the two channel modes disagree.
lesson: From receipts: repeated put on same key leaves first value (IGNORE). Channel=2 for two puts implies trigger present and total_changes (not changes()). Other connection only did ignored puts, so main vs main+other total_changes is ambiguous; resolve only when they agree.
